name: spec-first
description: Spec-governed development: write the stage ledger first, fix defects at the stage that produced them, and never compensate downstream.

interface.shortDescription: Fix where the first bad state is produced, not where it surfaces.
interface.longDescription: Keeps a specification and its code in agreement. New work starts from a stage ledger of inputs, outputs, invariants, and order. Every bug or changed requirement is diagnosed to the first stage that produced a bad state, fixed there with the spec updated first, and audited for compensating patches and stage-order drift.
